definitions.explanation: The act of gathering, organizing, and consolidating information, opinions, or tasks into a coherent whole. Also used for the role of coordinating people or processes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}りまとめ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}りまとめ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: Please have the report compiled by next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}りまとめて、⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作成|さくせい}した→作成する：25378_sakuseisuru⟧。
examples.english: I consolidated the various opinions that came up in the meeting and created a final proposal.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb {取|と}りまとめる (to compile, to coordinate). Widely used in business and administrative contexts for the process of gathering and organizing information or coordinating tasks.

USAGE:
Very common in workplace Japanese. Often appears as {取|と}りまとめ{役|やく} (coordinator, person in charge of pulling things together). The verb form {取|と}りまとめる is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取|と}りまとめ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧ — to carry out compilation/coordination
- {取|と}りまとめ{役|やく} — coordinator, organizer
- ⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{取|と}りまとめ — compilation of opinions
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{取|と}りまとめ — final consolidation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦まとめ→まとめ：10506_matome⟧ — summary (shorter, more casual)
- ⟦{集約|しゅうやく}→集約：14664_shuuyaku⟧ — consolidation, aggregation (more formal)
- ⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧ — coordination, adjustment (focuses on balancing)
